title: K-flatness in constant-module etale coordinates
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A$ a commutative ring, and $P$ a cochain complex of sheaves of $A$-modules on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $A_T$ be the constant sheaf of rings [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Apply degreewise the canonical constant-module realization from sheaves valued in $A$-modules to sheaves of modules over $A_T$. Define $\operatorname{etaleKFlat}(T,A,P)$ to mean that this realized complex is K-flat in the independent-coefficient sense of [def-pc-kflat-complex]: its direct-sum total tensor with every acyclic $A_T$-module complex is acyclic. This is the existing constant-module coordinate expression of K-flatness, with no boundedness or finiteness assumption.
